name: DonutShop v0.7.10
body:
**Misc**
- Initial RT6X CE support has been added
- Cleaned up i2c card layout in the Expert section
- WebCtl websocket reconnects automatically after waking / disconnected
- For 0:/profile/ and subfolders, Profiles can be sorted by Type or Name by clicking on "Name"
  - Type: .rt4 files are listed A->Z first, then .rt6 files. Mimics the On Screen "Load From File" menu
  - Name: files are listed A->Z regardless of type. Default behavior for all other 0:/ folders.
- Profiles in 0:/profile/ and subfolders now have 4k / 6X icons that represent the model that created the profile.
